# Trimble Connect Topics Exchange Service (BCF)

- **Definition:** [topic-exchange-prod@v1](https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/Trimble-Connect/topic-exchange-prod/v1), status ga. Security schemes: Bearer.
- **Regions:** ap, ap-au, eu, us.
- **Calling from the MCP:** pass the operation `key` (`topic-exchange:METHOD path`) to `trimble_api_read` (read) or `trimble_api_plan` (plan), with `product: "trimble-connect"`. Path, query and header parameters are validated against this catalogue.
